Having managed three in twenty there was now a long gap before Bill Matthews, Geoff Pearson and Don Bonser arrived almost together; some twenty minutes later Alan Bishop jogged happily in.

Charlie Walker (44th) led the Belgrave Vets to second place in the Veterans section aided by Arthur Bruce and Bill Matthews. Charlie qualified for third vet's prize and is being nominated by Basildon A.C. as Speaker of the Year at the next Town Crier's Championship!.
